image_description: A close-up macro shot of a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied to human skin, likely a finger. The bandage features a custom hand-drawn illustration in black ink and red marker, depicting a cartoonish character or symbol. Two human fingertips are visible pressing down on the right side of the bandage. The background is a blurred, neutral textured surface.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of bandage near fingertips
artifact_observations.reasoning: The boundary between the bandage edge and the skin/fingertips is somewhat ambiguous. The bandage seems to merge slightly with the skin tone without a sharp shadow or clear physical thickness, suggesting minor generation artifacts in contact regions.
The fingernails appear overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine vertical ridges and cuticle detail typical of high-resolution macro photography.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the drawn ink and the bandage texture. AI often fails to simulate how ink sits on porous fabric. Also, scrutinize the fingertips for 'waxy' or over-smoothed textures which are common generative artifacts in close-ups.
